review:
The Bonanza engine down on the farm. Symbols pay anywhere and reels refill after wins.

In free spins, multipliers worth 2x to 100x land and stay until the refill sequence ends, then they all add together and multiply that sequence – two or three in one sequence can add up to something big. Four, five or six scatters give 10, 20 or 30 spins. High volatility, 15,000x max, 95.97% RTP. Friendly look, demanding game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
